items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.description: The US Department of Justice said one of the men continued to communicate with contacts from prison in New York.

items.title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
items.description: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

items.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
items.description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

items.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
items.description: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

items.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
items.description: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

items.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
items.description: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.

items.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
items.description: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.

items.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
items.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

items.title: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
items.description: Sixty-nine people died in the collision near Toledo two weeks ago and 28 are still in hospital.

items.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
items.description: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

items.title: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
items.description: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.

items.title: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
items.description: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
